governance: Machine-adjudicated SILVER labels only. Output of this protocol must never be described as human/expert gold. No human review gate is included in this pilot; final naming must be 'machine-adjudicated silver set'.

task.unit: one role-conditioned question over one NERC event-analysis document
task.input_to_annotators: document sentences with stable sids + question + question role; NO prior labels, NO other annotator output

annotator_output_schema.evidence_sentence_ids: array of sid strings present in the document; empty allowed only when answerable=false or abstain=true
annotator_output_schema.evidence_role: one of: direct_answer | partial_answer | background | insufficient
annotator_output_schema.confidence: high | medium | low (ranking only, NOT a calibrated probability)

sampling.rule: deterministic RNG(seed) stratified sample over the 75 questions: cover all 15 documents and all 5 roles as evenly as possible; sample ids are part of the frozen ledger

annotator_A.note: record response-returned model id for version-drift check

adjudicator_C.note: record upstream model id returned; C sees only disagreements

generation_params.response_format: single JSON object, no prose outside JSON

deterministic_checks: every cited sid exists in the source document
evidence_sentence_ids non-empty when answerable=true and abstain=false
adjudication_rule: C is invoked only when A and B disagree on answerable, evidence set (exact sid-set equality), or evidence_role, or when either abstains. C sees the document, question, both labels anonymized as annotator_1/annotator_2, and deterministic check results. C outputs a final label with the same schema plus adjudication_note, or ABSTAIN.
stop_conditions: 5 consecutive auth or format failures for one model -> halt and report
any model returns a served model id different from the frozen id -> halt that annotator and report
ledger_requirements: append-only raw responses; separate parsed labels; record model id, timestamp, prompt_sha256, input/output tokens, latency, cost fields when returned; never log API keys
prohibited: retrying because a result is disliked
uploading anything beyond the public NERC packet
